whitebox_paths: eight fixed block0 paths per H32 window; three selected fork/reference/null pairs replayed across two fresh processes
natural_reference_selection: sealed until contrast allocation and benchmark policy are frozen; never used to select candidates
validation_rule: two random controls first, then six event/persistent/transient/sparse-miss mechanism slots alternating datasets; <=2/window; block0 only
validation_hypothesis: one frozen fixed-window event probability contrast per selected alternative; Holm family of eight tests; other measurements descriptive
cpd_validation_rule: two maximum adjacent event gaps from block0 plus one uniform remaining adjacent transition; one frozen event each; separate Holm family of nine comparisons
sga: independent port of pinned author code; K20 per independent block, slices4, DTW/length, seasonal scale floor1e-4, threshold0.25, alpha0.1,1+top20 entropy; H32/q50 adaptation
stopping_gate: stop after bounded collection, analysis and handoff; no automatic expansion
